title: Gerard B
content: I was in an auto accident. I died and was revived at the scene. I was diagnosed as clinically dead 3 separate times, over a couple days in the hospital trauma ward. I was first asked by an angel a specific question about the future. After answering, I was told that I would not die permanently for now. I must have given a correct answer, because I went into a tunnel-like cavern and placed before an interrogator. They were on the other side of a stream. I didn’t use words. In the end I was asked about water or blood. I chose water and was taken by the river to a camp. I was left in the camp. The second time I died, I was in a desert in the middle east. I saw dead celebrities there. I was called by my designated spiritual advisor. I’m not sure to this day if they had my best interest at heart. I was going to be removed by the celebrities when my advisor told me to wake up and go with them. We traveled together through the desert and arrived at my home. I asked my advisor her name. Her answer sounded like ‘Humiel.’ She said we would not likely meet in person again, and we didn’t. Then I went somehow to a barge. I was chained to the deck as a rower. A royal person was going to let me die, but a slave girl saved me and herself. We traveled together to a place where we were given food. But we were only supposed to eat certain things. I was talked into breaking that rule by a child. So, I had to endure a time of correction. During corrections, I was tempted by banshees for lack of a better word. I had to be rescued several times, but I got through that. The third time, I clearly remember being pronounced dead by doctors. I was in an imaging machine at the time. There was a discussion about how my wife was going to be told. I was standing and watching them talk about me. I did answer them, but they didn’t answer back. I was going to be put on an airplane and sent back to the desert to be cremated. I asked them not to do that, but nobody answered. My guide intervened when I arrived at the place, and I was taken to a house where I was asked (finally) why I was alive when my body was elsewhere. The fourth time, I remember again being declared dead. I was taken to a place where I was first talking with the occupants and telling them something bad was about to happen. We had a home invasion and I was strapped into a chair. When help came, nobody could find me. I used a something like a virtual chatroom to contact my guide to intervene for my rescue. Then I was placed in a trial where I was occasionally put in a room and given shock treatment. That last part was likely related to resuscitation. I remained in a semi-coma for another four weeks. So, it’s conceivable some of the things were part of that. I am pretty sure I left out any questionable details, erring on the side of caution. I died a once more in late April 2023. It was not nearly as dramatic and I didn’t meet my guide again. It was due to almost bleeding out from a GI ulcer. They transfused 8 units of blood into me. I was already in the hospital for pneumonia or there would have been no way I would have survived. That time was a lot more pleasant for me. I remember watching the doctors and not actually feeling like I was going to stay dead. Oddly when I regained consciousness, I couldn’t see people’s heads. That was the really scary thing from that experience.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes, Accident, Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function)
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, Aware of events not normally adjacent to my location. Some was more telepathic.
elements.At what time during the experience were: The first time at the beginning; subsequent times it was the second half to near the end. The 2023 event was about the center.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning, At times, I felt thrown back thousands of years or forward. Sometimes, it was like treading water.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: Darker than usual initially, then brighter.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, but the facts have not been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes, It was a tunnel with a river, and I was questioned by a being on the other side. There was an incredibly dark opening behind them. They stood behind a lectern, and it felt like they were either sending me down the river or into the dark place, depending on my responses. The dark place had a disjointed sound emitting from it.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes, I was not certain, but a face observed me during my resuscitation. It could have been Jesus, one of the disciples, or a prophet. There was silent communication to me that 'everything is going to be okay.'
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes, Several different times. It was not overwhelmingly bright and seemed to have no specific source.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm, It was a celestial room for healing, surrounded by something not peaceful.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: All over the place, from fear to love.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt no longer in conflict with nature
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from my personal future, Scenes not necessarily related to life on earth.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will, I was told I could not permanently die.
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Christian- Catholic, I was spending time with my wife at an Eastern Orthodox church.
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes, I'm definitely more certain of a continuation of the spirit after physical death.
elements.What is your religion now?: Christian- Catholic, I’m a dedicated anti-schismatic. I always have been to some degree, but it has become of paramount importance.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, I seemed to have been in an in-between place. Some might call it purgatory, but it was more akin to The Great Divorce described by C.S. Lewis than traditional thought. It was not exactly like that, but closer to that than the typical idea of purgatory.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes, Forbearance and unconditional love are probably the most important things. Material things are not important. It really is true you can’t take it with you. My one new fear is cremation. I was uncomfortable with it before, but now it feels like being sent to hell.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin, It was mostly my guide, for lack of a better word. I'm not sure if they had my best interests in mind. It almost seemed like they had unrelated reasons for being there, but I don't think they intended to harm me.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes, I'm guessing that one of the angels was Uriel. I'm rather certain that the other two angels were Raphael and Gabriel.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, The universe is a whole and connected place. In the healing place we were at, the angels needed to get water from a distant source. That source was from the beginning of the current cycle.
Yes, I was shown just a glimpse of the universe, and understood how we will always be part of it in some fashion.
elements.Did you gain information about how to li: Uncertain, Harmony and fairness are imperative. People will generally view something done selflessly with suspicion.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, Honest love was the most important aspect of life, and maintaining it was the difficult part.

Yes, Love, and by extension generosity, was paramount to harmony and happiness; not just in this world but even more importantly when we leave it. Without love, chaos and a dreadful noise take over, which is quite unpleasant. Those who suffer from it seem to want others to share in it.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: My fear of death has vanished. I now know when we leave this earth, it’s not the end into a void.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes, Generally, I'm more tolerant. On the downside, I'm less concerned about day-to-day life.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes, Things were like being where our normal orientation of three dimensions did not apply, or communicating over distances, and in one instance being able to control weather.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, It was not like a dream that I typically could not recall half an hour after waking up.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes, I’m much better at sensing people and their emotions. I can also influence them to some extent.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Having already been examined by the 'examiner,' likely whom is commonly referred to as Uriel, which the western churches generally don’t acknowledge.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes, I was aware of its existence and knew some descriptions from written works. I had not explored it to any meaningful extent.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, It was when I came out of my coma completely, a month later. Some of my memories were definitely of the hospital or staff, but some were most decidedly not.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, I'm quite certain that the events after the first one were clinically significant because they were clinical death events, based on medical records.
elements.Did the questions asked and information: Yes, I'm leaving out the possibilities of some experiences that could be explained by being in a semi-comatose state. There are some possibilities that I had a more extensive experience. The latter is likely. One thing I know is that staying alive is more painful than death, in dying or afterwards. That might not be the case for people who are destined for the 'noise.'
